text:
Maya: Quick help needed 1 candidate accepted but requested a $15k sign-on. Our L5 cap is $10k. Can we get an exception routed?

Evan: Context: this hire is for the West Coast pilot team. If they don't start 2025-04-01 we miss a contractual milestone. Manager wants $15k and to pay 50% on first paycheck to secure start.

Tom (Recruiter): Offer signed this morning (09:12). Candidate is willing to start 4/1 if comp is approved; otherwise can delay but manager prefers immediate start.

Maya: Two asks: 1) approval to exceed the $10k cap by $5k (one-time sign-on); 2) payroll confirmation that 50% can be front-loaded on first paycheck.

Priya: Payroll can split the payment. However, any sign-on >$10k triggers Comp Committee + Finance approval for audit and budget code assignment. We'll need GL tagging as "sign-on bonus" for Q2. Also confirm tax/how we withhold across tranches.

Evan: Manager justification: "Critical pilot deliverable; backfill to avoid penalty; candidate brings domain expertise; estimated ramp <6 weeks." Should be sufficient.

Maya: Good. Please paste these details into the comp-exception form: https://redwood.intra/comp-exceptions and attach signed offer.

Tom (Recruiter): Comp worksheet snippet pasted:
```
Base: $160,000
Level: L5
Band cap: $10,000
Requested sign-on: $15,000
Pay plan: 50% on first paycheck, 50% after 30 days
Justification: Critical pilot coverage; start 4/1 to meet milestone
```

People Ops Bot: Routing note: exceptions >$10k require Comp Committee + Finance. Include hiring manager approvals and attach the signed DocuSign. Ping @comp-committee for expedited review.

Maya: Form uploaded and attached to ticket HR-827. Routing to @comp-committee and @finance now.

Priya: I'll validate GL string and confirm payroll proration. If committee signs off today, we can pay for 4/1 start.

Evan: Also want confirmation on FICA and withholding for front-loaded tranche.

Priya: Withholding is normal per payroll. Splitting does not change tax rates; each tranche taxed in the pay period it is paid.

Tom (Recruiter): Candidate will accept an addendum via DocuSign today if we confirm by 17:00 PST.

Maya: Flagging precedent risk: comp committee, recommend marking this as a one-off for pilot hires and adding a note to lessons learned.

Comp Committee Chair: Acknowledged. Will review immediately; aim to respond before 17:00 PST.

People Ops Bot: Update: Chair pinged. Emergency agenda created for expedited decision.

Evan: If approved, reassign budget to team 1402 (Pilot).

Priya: Will post final GL string once approved.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update offer addendum and confirm with candidate once we have final sign-off. :thumbsup:
